headword: {推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}

definitions.explanation: A novel centered on solving a crime or puzzle through reasoning, typically a murder investigated by a detective. {推理|すいり} means deduction or reasoning.

examples.japanese: {推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}が{好|す}きだ。
この{推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}の{犯人|はんにん}が{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I can't figure out the culprit in this mystery novel.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}{作家|さっか}で、{何|なん}{冊|さつ}もベストセラーを{出|だ}している。
examples.english: She is a famous mystery novelist who has produced several best-sellers.

notes:
Compound of {推理|すいり} (deduction, reasoning) + {小説|しょうせつ} (novel). The story revolves around using logic to identify a culprit or solve a mystery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}を{読|よ}む: to read a detective novel
- {本格|ほんかく}{推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}: orthodox mystery (puzzle-focused)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {探偵|たんてい}{小説|しょうせつ}: detective fiction — an older term, nearly synonymous
- ミステリー: mystery — a broader loanword that also covers thrillers and suspense
